# AgentStack

> Public documentation for integrators and AI agents. Platform line 0.4.18. Public MCP catalog: 656 actions, 57 domains (650+ / 55+ shorthand).

- [Plugins](https://github.com/agentstacktech/AgentStack/blob/master/docs/plugins/README.md): Cursor, Claude, GPT, Gemini, VS Code
